description: Implementation of CMSIS RTOS v2 mutex functions for Zephyr OS, including mutex creation, acquisition, release, deletion, and querying owner and name.

methods.name: osMutexNew
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new mutex object with specified attributes or defaults.

methods.name: osMutexAcquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the mutex, waiting up to the specified timeout.

methods.name: osMutexDelete
methods.description: Deletes a mutex, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: osMutexGetOwner
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the mutex owner, if any.

methods.name: osMutexGetName
methods.description: Returns the name of the mutex.
